items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: I don't know Joe Lewis. I know Walter Lewis.

ctx.x: Oh, sometime, Eddie Summers, that's his, I used to use Eddie Summers. You ever use a piano? Piano, yeah. We use a piano. Now this boy, I see this boy all the time and I can't think of his name. He's old. Joe Lewis. He's a Dixieland fool.
I don't know Joe Lewis. I know Walter Lewis. Little bit of Brownskins, brother. Stay back on Pearl Street. Oh, I don't know where he lives. It might be the same guy that might
have two names. He drinks a whole lot. That's him. That was his regular piano. That was Thomas' regular piano player. We called him Joe Lewis, all in the
